newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures close tightly mixed, still in range.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures close tightly mixed, still in range.

text.p: Frozen concentrated orange juice futures settled weaker and near session lows amid follow-through speculative selling from Friday, market sources said.
May ended 1.55 cents lower at 74.60 cents per lb. Most-active July closed down 1.30 cents at 76.45 cents, traded 78.40 to 76.10 cents.
Volume was estimated at 5,000 lots compared with Friday's official 8,471 lots.

Activity is expected to remain dull with little change in the fundamental outlook. The world supply and demand situation remains bearish as Florida is set to produce a record 221.2 million 90-lb boxes, with yields estimated at 1.57 gallons per box.
The weekly movement, meantime, remains consistently weak.
Brazil, which is also expected to produce a huge crop for the current season, will release its first estimate for the 1997/98 crop, in late May.
